question: Can a dynamically compiled agent context reduce fresh-agent startup cost without turning AGENTS.md into mutable source-of-truth state?
hypothesis: A deterministic session-local AGENTS.md compiled from Git commits, WORK refs and experiment records will preserve decision-critical startup state while remaining disposable, untracked and smaller than raw reconstruction context.

conditions.rationale: A tracked runtime projection would be self-referential: committing HEAD-dependent context changes HEAD and immediately invalidates the snapshot.

benchmark.recallDomain: head, live WORK ownership/lease/dependencies/scopes/resources/contracts, running experiments, recent causal changes and next decision

variants.startup: static AGENTS.md + compiled usegit agents context
